written.headline: Anthropic releases FlashProve to cryptographically verify AI model responses
written.summary: Anthropic unveiled FlashProve, an open‑source prototype that generates cryptographic proofs showing a language‑model reply came from a specific set of weights. The system runs at about 110 tokens per second on Meta’s Llama 4 Maverick, with proofs around 19 MB that a CPU can check in 17‑21 seconds.

written.headline: Revolut cuts AI coding inference costs by about 90% with self‑hosted GLM
written.summary: Revolut reduced its AI coding inference spend to roughly one‑tenth of prior costs by self‑hosting open‑weight GLM models from Z.ai on its own NVIDIA GPUs. The change improved engineering lead time by 70% and coding time by 60% for about 2,000 engineers.

written.headline: Apple opens Siri AI to all developers via App Intents in iOS 27.3 beta
written.summary: Apple announced that developers can integrate Siri AI into any iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and visionOS app using App Intents, starting with the iOS 27.3 beta. The preview lets apps expose content and actions for natural‑language requests without naming the app.

written.headline: Meta targets at least $20 billion in cross‑border bond offering, debuting euro tranche
written.summary: Meta Platforms is preparing a cross‑border investment‑grade bond sale that could raise at least $20 billion, including its first euro‑denominated tranche and its first major debt transaction in six months. Citigroup and Morgan Stanley will host investor calls as the company seeks funding for AI and data‑center expansion.

written.headline: AI inference startup Fal valued at $16B after $1.3B funding round
written.summary: Fal, a San Francisco AI inference startup, raised $1.3 billion in a Series F round led by Bessemer Venture Partners, valuing the company at $16 billion after reporting $800 million in annualized revenue.

written.headline: Google disables Search for schools that reject its AI tools
written.summary: Google will turn off Search for K‑12 accounts unless administrators enable its Gemini AI suite, meaning schools that block AI lose web search access.
